result.process_description:
Title: App For Participating at the Vienna Night Run

If you want to participate at the Vienna Night Run, you need to select a starting block first.
After that, you run for 5km and measure the time.
If you can do it in less than 25 minutes, you are good.
If not, you need to train and check until you have achieved this goal.
After that, you can get your starting number.
Depending on when your work day ends, you have to find out whether you can go there from home, or need to leave directly from work.
If more than one hour is left between your starting time and the end of your workday, you can go there from home.
Else, you need to leave directly from work.
While running at the Night Run, you run and drink at the same time.
In the end, you receive your final running time.

Some of the above information you have to enter into the app, some of the information is collected by fitness gadgets.

result.rule: When the description states that two or more actions occur at the same time, or that one action is independent of another after a shared prerequisite: Model the actions on separate branches from a parallel gateway. Use a parallel join only before a continuation that requires all those branches to finish.

When the description names multiple required activities that must be completed before a later activity, without specifying an order among them: Model the activities as separate parallel branches and synchronize them before the later activity.

When the description says an activity may or may not occur before the process continues: Model mutually exclusive paths for performing or skipping the activity, then merge the paths before the next step.

When the description lays out activities in an order, or requires several activities to finish before a later stage or process end.: Connect the activities with sequence flows that preserve the stated order; when every required activity must finish before proceeding, synchronize their paths with a parallel gateway.
